title: Biomechanical Synthesis — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Biomechanical Synthesis' rich face, its first round, a Sketch and a proposal: the May hub of eight instruments gathered beside the list; one compressor with two faces, a meter and a body, proved one arithmetic and offered as a test a reader can take of whether the face changes what a hand sets (not of memory, which is the page's claim and no sitting can test); Blood Compressor's vessel pointed at rather than remade; and an inhibitory network that takes its inhibition away and counts what the rhythm loses, beside gaps put at random. I grow when a reader pool comes back, or when another of the eight instruments is built. I never hold the entry's words.
grain: The page's own ## grain: three sections carry pieces (Eight Synthesizer Concepts, Visceral Pedagogy, The Neural Network Synthesis Paradigm); each is stamped and approved on its own.

pieces.title: the eight-instrument hub · May 2026
pieces.caption: **The list, as a map.** Eight instruments, each a biological system and the DSP job it does, with its state as of 2026-05-04: only the neural oscillator built, five specified, two seeds. The marks are May's. Since then Blood Compressor and Slime Mold Delay have pages, prototypes and rich faces of their own (the page's first Forward Vector says so, 2026-10-24). Node 04 reads *vessel pressure / pulse → gain / attack*, the same mapping as item 4: a design choice that Blood Compressor, the instrument item 4 spawned, did not take (see the offers).

pieces.near: You'll never forget how a compressor works
pieces.title: one compressor, two faces · and a test you can take
pieces.caption: **What kind of claim is this?** *You'll never forget* is a claim about memory, over weeks, in students. No piece can test it in a sitting, and this one doesn't. It walks up in five steps to something smaller. First a plain meter on one steady tone. Then the loop and the two knobs about time. Then the same compressor as a body: pressure in mmHg, the vessel's width as the gain, item 4's mapping. A null subtracts one face's output from the other and leaves −282 to −320 dB on six settings. That checks the code: the body face is coded as the same compressor in other units, and a millimetre wall, a different algebra, would show (−19 to −31 dB). Then item 4's pulse. Here the pulse is the input by construction, read before the wall, so the step shows a design choice (Blood Compressor's), not a finding. Last, the same task three times on faces a coin picks, numbers hidden. What is compared is fixed in the piece's code and shown only after the third try, so it can't steer a hand. Each reader gets a line to pool, and the piece scores a pasted pool. No agent is a reader, so it ships with no verdict. The body here is red, not grotesque, so the disgust the page names is not tested either.

pieces.near: A student who builds a hydraulic blood compressor
pieces.title: the vessel, built · from Blood Compressor's bundle
pieces.caption: **The hydraulic blood compressor this sentence imagines, as it stands.** Blood Compressor's Stage 2 prototype (v3, the steward's, 2026-10-14): the vessel clamps when pressure crosses the systolic line, the baroreceptors light, the width follows the gain. Gathered from that page's bundle, not remade; its rich face carries the attack lesson (the attack floor: the knob cannot go under 5 ms) and the stressed body. Note it is a student *watching* a vessel narrow, not building one; whether building it burns the concept in is still the page's untested claim.

verdicts.why: A real test, rule fixed first; the drive-under-1 fall reproduces (199/200; composite 146/46, per onset 163/37). Note: there the rhythm exists without inhibition (entropy 0.00, LHL 34) and inhibition silences 169 of 600 voices outright, so “the page is wrong here” should read “T1 fails where the rhythm exists without inhibition”, with the 169/600 in the caption.

pieces.title: negative space · does inhibition make the rhythm?
pieces.caption: **Build the network, then take the inhibition away.** A steady trigger, sixteen to a bar, and leaky integrate-and-fire nodes (V ← 0.85V + w, fire at 1). The piece walks up from one node on every trigger, to one node dividing the trigger, to three nodes layered, to inhibition (a firing node takes g from the others; outlines show what it silenced). The test's rule was written before the first run: 200 random networks, each in three arms (with inhibition, without, and the same number of gaps put at random). **Drives under 1**, the run the rule was written for: the rhythm exists without inhibition (each node a clock divider), and T1 fails there. Inhibition *lowers* syncopation in 199 of 200 networks (34.0 to 16.6 per bar, Longuet-Higgins and Lee, summed over three nodes). Part of that is whole voices silenced, 169 of 600, the page's own *silences competing frequency regions*. But the fall holds on measures that don't count silenced voices: the whole network falls in 146 and rises in 46, and per note falls in 163 and rises in 37 (challenger's check). Its gaps are still more regular than chance (interval entropy 0.19 bits against 0.93, 159 to 4). **Drives 1 to 2**, added after with the rule unchanged (the page's *a single trigger reaches*): syncopation goes from nothing to 19.2 in 200 of 200, and the gaps are regular (0.11 against 1.84 bits). There T1 can hardly fail, so the weight is on T2. Mixed drives show the condition is *every* node: with one node over 1, syncopation rises in 0 of 200. A model, not a brain.

offers.what: 'Inhibitory connections — one neuron firing SUPPRESSES others → competitive rhythmic patterns, syncopation' holds when the trigger alone would fire every node, and not otherwise. Measured on 200 random three-node leaky networks (negative space piece, check.mjs; challenger's check). With drives 1 to 2, syncopation rose from 0 to 19.2 in 200 of 200. With one node over 1 and two under, it rose in 0 of 200. With drives 0.5 to 1.5 it showed nothing either way (85 rise, 102 fall). With drives under 1, where the nodes already make a rhythm without inhibition, inhibition lowered syncopation in 199 of 200 (34.0 to 16.6 per bar; whole network 146 fall to 46 rise; per note 163 to 37) and silenced 169 of 600 voices outright, though its gaps stayed more regular than random gaps at the same density (0.19 vs 0.93 bits). Suggest the paragraph say that inhibition makes syncopation from a trigger that would fire every node, and that where nodes already integrate, it thins and silences the rhythm they make.

Bring item 4 into line with the instrument it spawned. 'Pulse rate = attack time' is a design choice Blood Compressor did not take: there 'the audio signal is the heartbeat' and attack is the 'baroreceptor reflex delay' (Projects/Blood Compressor.md:36, :48). The two-faces piece follows Blood Compressor, so its pulse is the input by construction. It is evidence of nothing beyond that choice. Merged in: 'vessel diameter = gain reduction' says the opposite of Blood Compressor's 'Wider vessel = louder' (Projects/Blood Compressor.md:59) and of this page's own Visceral Pedagogy ('a vessel narrowing under pressure'): the diameter is the gain, and its narrowing is the reduction. Suggest: 'blood pressure = amplitude, vessel narrowing = gain reduction, the baroreceptor reflex delay = attack time; the heartbeat is the signal.' The May hub SVG's node 04 carries the old mapping; it is a dated record and stays as made.
